{{Quote|Attack on my signal. Show no mercy. The sooner we finish this job&mdash;the sooner we can leave this miserable system.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Rohn]], to [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Hock Malsuum]]|<ref name="CoS3" />}}
The '''Ostor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Koradin sector/Legends|Koradin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ostor]].<ref name="CoS3" />
